system.description:
CHANCE FOCUS RYUKARI TECHNIQUE

To the Fuku, fortune is not random. It is a current—and sometimes a sufficiently skilled hand can redirect its flow.

Prerequisites Fuku Heritage, Level 5

Action R; Trigger you fumble an attack check, skill check or saving throw

Reroll the triggering check and use the second result, even if it is worse.

Automated: when you fumble an attack check (the fumble confirmed, before the fumble table), a skill check or a saving throw, you are asked whether to use it: your reaction in combat and its Focus use, and the check is rerolled and the second result used, even if it is worse.
